Showing all levels. Tap a button to switch.

Modified Level 1 (Basic + Advanced), Level 2 and Level 3 materials for SLE students in the Culinary 1 inclusion class. Students stay in the gen ed lesson and use these pieces next to it: same units, same order, same due dates. Level 3 is closer to the class work (readings, guided notes, quick checks). Notes, readings and quizzes have a 🔊 Read aloud version.

🧼 Unit 1: Safety & Sanitation

Hazards, germs, hand washing, gloves, the Danger Zone, cooking temperatures, storing, thawing and cleaning. Food Worker Card prep.
Goes with the class Canvas module: “Safety & Sanitation Videos & Resources”.
